content: PartyKit was acquired by Cloudflare (April 2024) and remains actively maintained in 2026 (GitHub releases through March 2026, active issues through July 2026). It runs on Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects. Two deployment modes exist: (1) managed PartyKit cloud (partykit.io) — zero-cost dev tier, usage-based pricing for production, simplest setup; (2) 'cloud-prem' self-deploy to your own Cloudflare account via the PartyKit CLI — free for the PartyKit layer itself, you pay only Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects costs, requires a Cloudflare account + API token. Cloudflare Durable Objects have been available on the Workers Free plan since April 2025 (100K requests/day, 5GB storage), so cloud-prem no longer requires the paid Workers plan for small-scale use.
